name: poet

attributes.attribute: the same figure as the bard

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Poet is the word for the bard in Celtic tradition. The craft of poetry was a form of magic in Ireland, tied to incantation and enchantment. A fully trained poet could travel a circuit of the land. See Bard for the fuller account.
